subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events, and what credential, scope, and config contract should it expose?
rationale: The remaining request changes which Space messages OpenClaw can see, how Google credentials are stored, and whether OpenClaw owns an Events/Pub/Sub subscription lifecycle, which requires maintainer product and security intent before code work is safe.

options.title: Design plugin-local OAuth/Events ingestion
options.body: Keep the issue open and define a Google Chat plugin-owned SecretRef-backed OAuth or Workspace Events contract before implementation.

options.title: Limit core to mention-based bot webhooks
options.body: Close or narrow the all-message portion and document that full Space ingestion is out of scope for the bundled plugin until a separate external integration owns it.

options.title: Defer until OAuth issue lands
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on #9764 and revisit all-message ingestion only after the user OAuth credential model is accepted.

recommendation.title: Design plugin-local OAuth/Events ingestion
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and define a Google Chat plugin-owned SecretRef-backed OAuth or Workspace Events contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is closest to recent Google Chat auth/channel review and the security-sensitive OAuth decision surface.
